name: Override: preload into a Goal with actions
description: Puts the preloaded Red Pin in the red left Goal. The lift and claw move during the drives: one action at the start of a drive, one when a motion ends and one after a time. The aligner under the claw centres the Pin on the Goal.

steps.note: the aligner centres the Pin over the Goal, then the claw lets go
back away, then lower the lift 0.5 s later
